info.name: SMS Coupon Sender
info.description: Flow: 1) Upload CSV  2) Start (dry run first)  3) Poll status  4) Download result CSV. Select the 'SMS Coupon Sender - Local' environment first. The server's SMS_MODE (.env) decides which Push SMS endpoint is used - single, bulk or dynamic - and every job reports its choice as 'mode'.

item.name: 1. Upload CSV (validate and load, sends nothing)

exec: console.log('Preview of messages:', body.preview, '| estimated minutes:', body.estimatedMinutes);

formdata.description: Set true to upload a file that was already sent

request.description: Pick your CSV in the 'file' field. The response shows counts (pending / skipped), a preview of the first 3 SMS texts, an estimated duration and 'mode' (the Push SMS endpoint this job will use). Check the preview before starting. Uploading an already-sent file returns 409 unless force=true.
Runs the full pipeline without calling SSL Wireless. A dry-run job cannot be re-used for a real send: upload the file again.
Sends real SMS. Also use this to resume a job with status 'halted' after fixing the cause (token, balance...).

status: ready | running | halted | completed | cancelled | failed. mode: single | bulk | dynamic (the Push SMS endpoint in use, fixed when the job starts). counts: pending, sending, sent, failed, skipped, unknown, dry_run.
Stops sending. Requests already in flight finish; the rest stay 'pending' and are never sent.

Columns: contact_no, stage, status (PENDING / SENDING / SENT / FAILED / SKIPPED / UNKNOWN / DRY_RUN), response, message, sending_time. 'response' is compact JSON for that row: the API result (status, status_code, error_message) plus the SMS result (sms_status, status_message, msisdn, reference_id). Original file order. Rows not processed yet have an empty response. Use 'Send and Download' in Postman to save it.
